missionPremise: cad_property holds multiple tax years per parcel; the current-value scalar fill discards everything but the latest via DISTINCT ON. This is ingest of data already held, cut from the acquisition list by the planner (exactly the class of mistake the parcel-record-is-the-gate ruling names as most expensive). Scalar rails stay current-only; history is companion; Williamson rides the R1B crosswalk.
completionPredicate: Met. valueHistory earned (value, never fabricated) on all six counties, every county's rowCount sum exactly matching its landing denominator -- zero orphans, zero leaks. Two things checked and correctly NOT done: cad_property_vintage_crosswalk/fallback (a pre-built, indexed cross-vintage mechanism that looks purpose-built for this) was found unusable (zero rows for any of the six program counties) rather than assumed usable from its schema alone; a per-page Williamson crosswalk join that did not complete in 5+ minutes on live data was fixed (materialized once per county) before shipping, not discovered as a production failure. Williamson's crosswalk-matched count (257,604) independently verified to exactly match PARCEL-R1B-REINGEST's own documented figure.

whatContradictedTheCard: Nothing about the mission itself. Two design-time findings this session's own prior card (PARCEL-R4-COMPANIONS) had already surfaced the shape of, applied here proactively: (1) an unbatched per-row or per-page-unindexed write/join pattern does not scale to this program's county sizes and needs fixing before the first live --apply, not after; (2) a piece of infrastructure that LOOKS purpose-built for a problem (cad_property_vintage_crosswalk) must be checked for actual population before being trusted, not assumed usable from its schema.

LESSON: A same-session lesson (zone-major materialization, batched writes) generalizes across cards touching the same store, not just within one card -- apply it proactively on the NEXT card's first implementation rather than waiting to rediscover it live.

Infrastructure that structurally matches a problem (cad_property_vintage_crosswalk's schema is an exact conceptual fit for cross-vintage parcel identity) can still be entirely unpopulated for the scope that needs it. Check population, not just schema fit, before designing around an existing table.
